children: Bitwise and Vise have launched diversified crypto model portfolios for financial advisors through the Vise platform. According to Odaily, the portfolios place crypto assets alongside stocks, bonds, and alternative assets within a single household portfolio framework, with Vise handling allocation, rebalancing, and tax management while Bitwise provides crypto research and model construction. Vise’s network covers more than 135,000 accounts and over $140 billion in platform assets, while Bitwise manages more than $9 billion in client assets.

title: Bitwise and Vise Launch Diversified Crypto Model Portfolios for Financial Advisors
